observations.detail: Growing invitations use their own experimental version, four distinct independent semantic relationships, two representations and two explicit sessions. A later-session unassisted first attempt may confirm missing coverage once per case/representation without adding a distinct case. Same-session repeats and help cannot supply that coverage. limitedEvidence and educator review remain; existing Phase3B policy/catalogue code and accepted ADRs are unchanged. Links neither duplicate mastery nor gate other domains.

The extracted legacy v1 decode-method body is exactly equal to the base after CRLF-to-LF normalization only: 4702 characters, SHA256 4d05d2490eb2b4c19f3bdcf44b7c30ee34dda7c98e1f4fa7455da9e76e2dde36. Combined dispatch preserves canonical v1 identity, rejects chapter fields under v1 and v2 under the legacy reader, and does not upgrade during decoding.

Chapter selection, explicit mathematical-help requests in original assessed families, or explicit Stop at the full legacy-journal edge upgrade to v2 through a write. Legacy pending commands settle first. Prior events/derived state, preferences, counts and integrity envelope survive. Full-legacy Stop closes without appending an impossible 65th legacy event; the next v2 session clears support and advances the task ordinal.

v2 policy chapter pending requires a non-null bounded observation matching selected family, correctness, operation and session. Pending IDs cannot already exist in either journal. The maximum saved help tier is enforced by preparation and pending decoding; chapter worked help forces solutionExposed. Legacy support matching derives its actual family from the observation catalogue scope, so changing selectedFamily cannot evade assistance. Original-family tier3 remains mathematicalSupport without inventing worked-solution exposure. Unknown/raw-answer fields and future-session/foreign-scope evidence are rejected.

Focused application tests cover aborted final write, committed write with lost response, one logical completion after reconciliation, former-profile response suppression after a switch, and global deletion-fence rejection of surviving pending writes.

The stable repository namespace/layout remain distinct from payload version. New reader metadata declares both payloads under a new reader schema, and exact matching rejects old/incompatible targets. Synthetic adapter and full-database validator share a 4096-receipt bound with no pruning. There are 232 known support contexts: two profiles requesting all three increasing tiers plus136 answers at two writes each need 1936 writes before ordinary control writes; the conservative 256-context ceiling gives 2080. A 4096 limit provides bounded margin, not unlimited controls or production retention. Native 2084-receipt/full-map reopen remains separate browser evidence.

Discovery selection and Explore-to-practice preserve explicit manual mode. A separate visible child control changes whether practice guides invitations. Manual completions enter neither assessment journal. Exploration/NumberLab are session-only, and the workshop has no assessment submission API; separate practice generates a fresh task.

Legacy bridges need three distinct independent cases in frozen single-representation scopes. Repaired child connected-readiness copy says a related idea was tried independently without claiming multiple representations; chapter readiness labels still require actual representation/session diversity. All families remain selectable.

Reviewed base-to-candidate diff plus newly added modules/tests and retained synthetic evidence. No accepted policy/authority expansion, real learner material, telemetry/backend, new dependency/lockfile change, credential, binary export or raw database/browser-profile artifact observed in this reviewed candidate. Main quality review owns final artifact/privacy certification.

A bounded nonassessment semantic map records maximum requested help before UI reveal and is keyed by mathematical case, independent of seed/representation. It survives saved-profile switches, activity changes and reopen in the same session. Aborted/lost-response support writes fail closed in the requesting UI; committed metadata is recovered by reopen. Stale profile results and global-deletion-fenced writes are rejected. An explicit new v2 session alone clears context and generates a fresh replay; historical observations are never reclassified.

Both v1 and v2 records with 64 legacy events return sessionOnly unscored completion without a write for further old-assessed answers. Explicit Stop remains available by upgrading if necessary and preserving exact legacy journal/derived bytes. Resume advances the explicit session/task ordinal and clears only support metadata. Separate fixtures retain 64 legacy plus 72 chapter observations alongside all 232 finite support contexts under unchanged canonical limits.

The existing bounded-wire regression now expects the authorized unscored continuation while preserving its independent exact65th-event codec rejection. A new saved-session regression verifies canonical payload and journal unchanged, same revision and zero writes during unscored play, correct sessionOnly completion with no exploratory exposure increment, and Next/Stop preserving history and derived state.
